metadata.title: Physical Risk MOSS 100-Control Master Catalogue
metadata.purpose: Definitive 14-domain, 100-control source of truth for the MOSS manual, spreadsheet engine, SOMOD engine and SaaS platform.

domains.description: Defines executive authority, organisational accountability, decision rights, governance forums, escalation and records that make physical security controllable at leadership level.
Defines how threats, vulnerabilities, site risks, intelligence and treatment actions are identified, reviewed, owned and converted into security requirements.
Defines the document control system for policies, standards, post orders, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), approvals, deviations and review cycles.
Defines whether guard deployment is risk-aligned, physically delivered, properly supervised, time-band adjusted and financially efficient.
Defines how people, vehicles, contractors, visitors, restricted areas, credentials, keys, overrides and asset removals are authorised, verified and logged.
Defines physical boundary integrity, entry points, barriers, lighting, vulnerable points, locks and physical breach response.
Defines camera coverage, video management, detection systems, analytics, uptime, retention and surveillance evidence reliability.
Defines the control room as the operational truth point for alarm receipt, logging, dispatch, escalation, response and evidence traceability.
Defines how incidents are captured, classified, escalated, investigated, evidenced, costed, closed and linked back to controls and Service Level Agreement (SLA) outcomes.
Defines how physical assets, goods, inventory, dispatch, receiving, reconciliation, losses and recovery are controlled.
Defines vendor scope, measurable SLAs, performance reporting, penalty enforcement, data integrity, invoice linkage and accountability.
Defines role competency, grading, licensing, screening, training, supervision competency and personnel integrity requirements.
Defines emergency procedures, contacts, drills, emergency roles, continuity alignment, response equipment and after-action learning.
Defines internal audit, assurance, finding management, remediation, repeat issue tracking, dashboards, independent review and improvement governance.
